title: Copy-Shot Game
description: In this traditional shooting game, a leader calls and takes a shot; if it goes in, everyone must copy it exactly or collect a letter — five letters and you are out.

content.objective: Develop a range of shots with both hands and from different spots in a low-pressure game.
content.setup: Two to six players at one basket with one ball.
content.organization: Players take turns as the leader in a fixed order.
instructions: The leader calls the shot (spot, hand, type) before shooting.
If the leader makes it, each player in turn must copy it.
A player who misses the copy gets a letter.
If the leader misses, the next player becomes the leader.
Five letters and you are out; last player in wins.
coachingPoints: Call the shot clearly before shooting.
Choose shots you practise: weak-hand lay-ups, bank shots.
commonMistakes: Unrealistic trick shots that do not help development.
Copying without the same hand or spot.
content.safety: No dunks or hanging on the rim; shots from realistic spots only.
progressions: Only game shots allowed (no trick shots).
Each player must use the weak hand once as the leader.
regressions: Leader can only choose from a list of shots.
variations: Team version: teams of two copy each other.
Only shots from inside the lane.
successCriteria: Every called shot is copied exactly.
Uses at least one weak-hand shot as leader.
content.gameApplication: Players add shots to their game when they are free to try them in a game format.

annotations.text: Call it, make it, copy it
